snippet.title: VEILED | Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A war-torn, silenced world. Deep wounds left by conflict, and long forgotten stories wait to be uncovered.

Veiled is a horror-thriller survival experience where every step through the ruins uncovers remnants of a shattered past. Through the eyes of an orphaned girl struggling to make sense of a world that took everything from her, you'll journey across a dangerous, unknown world and uncover hidden stories all while trying to find your way out of it. Along the way, you'll face unsettling challenges, unexpected encounters, and moments of courage as hope shines through the darkness.

After months of development, we're excited to finally share our first official trailer.

Keep in touch, follow development, and join us as we continue bringing Veiled to life. The demo for Veiled will be out soon.
